messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: All my provinces have distribution and free homes but very many people are dying

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: Are they dying or moving out. The population rework was deployed. People now move to less crowded provinces.

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: All my provinces are losing populations

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: And the deaths are more than the max deaths per hour and that’s if I have no population growth

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: Then i will defer to dede on this.

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: This province has room for 2 billion people

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: It’s the same here

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: More room than I have people

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: And I have enough distribution here not that I need it because I am still within the 2 weeks of not requiring food

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: I thought the food grace period was 20 land or less. Not a 2 week period? Unless dede updated that.

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: 1 province 20 land or less is no food at all for good above that is two weeks

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: Either way this one has enough food and distribution but it hasn’t changed anything

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: I have no idea what my population was before this but I’m pretty sure it was 170m or just under it something like that

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: I shall give you 1 pop to rebuild your nation from. <:teacat:1521721302946287769>

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: His name shall be Adam.

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: It’s too late the plague has taken my nation there is no recovery

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: It will soon spread across terra

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: It chill apparently they just starved to death I thought it was 14 days of no food not 10 days and I thought it distribution was per province not nation wide

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: I don’t think they were supposed to starve thoigh

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: You don’t need food for 14 days and it’s only been 10 my provinces still said my population was getting distribution in every province too

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: We were told 2 weeks

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@429129579039555584> population 2.0 went live yesterday evening, so the old rules are gone. the 2 week grace only covers people emigrating from overcrowded provinces, it doesn't stop starvation. what matters now for food is the distribution capacity of your whole nation (distribution centers, malls etc): rations only reach as many people as your distribution buildings can serve, and anyone not covered starves, up to 1% of your people per hour. at 170m people you need a lot of capacity even if every province shows distribution. deaths also depend on hospitals (each covers 1m people, fewer hospitals = more elderly/child deaths). so build more distribution buildings and hospitals. if you think the new rules are too harsh, post it in #suggestions and it goes on the next ballot. restoring lost people is a staff decision
